text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B at a 59% loss was painful, but holding just to avoid admitting a mistake can be costly; I should review each position objectively and act on its prospects.","I repeatedly bought Stock E and sold it for almost no gain, then bought more at higher prices; I should avoid reactive trading and set clear reasons for entering and exiting before I trade.","Buying more Stock C and Stock E and adding Stock D did not by itself make my portfolio safer; I should check concentration, cash needs, and overall risk before adding to any position."]}
